validated_results.title: Resveratrol in prostate diseases - a short review.
validated_results.reason: The article is explicitly a short review summarizing published cell-line and animal resveratrol studies rather than reporting original human incidence data.

validated_results.title: Early growth inhibition is followed by increased metastatic disease with vitamin D (calcitriol) treatment in the TRAMP model of prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: Calcitriol and analog treatment was tested exclusively in the transgenic TRAMP mouse model, so no human evidence on prostate cancer incidence is provided.

validated_results.title: Prostate cancer in Asian men.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative review of prostate cancer epidemiology and management in Asian men in which Western diet is only mentioned as a possible explanatory factor, with no original study data.

validated_results.title: Adherence to Mediterranean diet and risk of cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies.
validated_results.reason: The publication is a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies of Mediterranean diet adherence and cancer risk, not an original primary study.

validated_results.title: Differential roles of PPARγ vs TR4 in prostate cancer and metabolic diseases.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative mechanistic review of PPARγ and TR4 nuclear receptor biology in which polyunsaturated fatty acid metabolites appear only as receptor ligands, not as a measured human dietary exposure.

validated_results.title: Genetic variants reflecting higher vitamin e status in men are associated with reduced risk of prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: The reported per-allele odds ratios concern single-nucleotide polymorphisms in vitamin E-related genes rather than a population-wide estimate for vitamin E intake or circulating concentrations.

validated_results.title: Filaggrin loss-of-function mutations and incident cancer: a population-based study.
validated_results.reason: The analyzed exposure is filaggrin loss-of-function genotype and vitamin D is mentioned only incidentally as a possible mechanism, so no vitamin D exposure estimate is provided.
